name: Ayakawa Mitsuki
source:
A plain 20-year-old girl who started working part-time

at the ramen shop "Kuragetei" run by the main character . Since graduating from middle school, she has been a recluse and is extremely bad at talking to people. However , there seems to be a reason why she still works at this shop ... She is a little chubby and has a large chest.
